kjv: rather than godly edifying which is in faith
mine: rather than the stewardship from God that is by faith
note: TR "oikodomian" (edifying) against "oikonomian" (stewardship, plan), the reading of all early manuscripts.

kjv: for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers
note: arsenokoitai as at 1 Cor 6:9; "andrapodistai" are slave-traders or kidnappers, the KJV's "menstealers" is accurate but obscure.
TR adds "sophos" (wise) from Rom 16:27; absent from Sinaiticus*, A, D*, F, G.
